articles.summary: We're excited to announce that we've now made Depot ephemeral registries available to depot bake commands so that you can save built images for multiple targets for later use in your CI workflows, to share with your team, or to push to remote registries.
articles.title: Now available: Depot ephemeral registry for bake

articles.summary: This article walks you through how to use Depot's API within your own code to set up projects and run your Docker builds as a service on Depot's infrastructure.
articles.title: Depot Build API: build Docker images as a service

articles.title: Depot is now SOC 2 compliant
